newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH surges 8.1 pct on one large buy order.
newsitem.headline: BPH surges 8.1 pct on one large buy order.

text.p: Polish Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH), one of the Warsaw bourse's large caps, surged 8.1 percent to 200 zlotys in the session's heaviest 20.2-million-zloty turnover possibly on one large buy order, analysts said.
"It seems that it was one order, an institutional buy, likely foreign as foreigners like the stock," one analyst said.

Some said the Monday's announcement that its planned convertible bond issue would amount to $100 million removed the uncertainty over the scale of the issue, which was halting the bank's growth before.
Some said, BPH could suffer from profit-taking in the next few sessions, but said the falls were unlikely to be of equal scale that the Tuesday's rise.
